_metadata.description: Immutable exact-hash release editions, owner-resolved provenance, rights and review evidence.

requirements.title: Release tracks pin exact catalog recording provenance
requirements.description: Every ordered release occurrence references an existing exact SHA-256 and pins the catalog take, source receipt reference, and existing operator track judgment into that immutable edition revision. Caller-supplied provenance is ignored, and a missing, rejected, or unreviewed catalog record cannot qualify for operator release review.

validation.notes: Test fixture builds an eligible multi-track revision from exact liked catalog hashes; forged provenance is discarded and unliked/missing hashes cannot pass.

requirements.title: Rights and lineage evidence cannot be asserted by draft fields
requirements.description: Operator rights decisions are durable append-only records bound to the exact release revision, track hash, catalog receipt, license, and usage scope. Derived-work readiness requires exact source and included derived hashes, verified owner operation evidence, and rights no wider than the most restrictive input.

validation.notes: Free-form rights fields, mismatched receipt refs, and unverified operation IDs fail; matching exact-hash decisions and verified owner evidence qualify the fixture.
REST rights decisions reject missing proof with precondition failure.

requirements.title: Operator release judgment is append-only and edition-pinned
requirements.description: A one-batch operator decision records the SHA-256 digest of the exact immutable release revision. Later edits create a new revision; no prior approval transfers, and database constraints prevent rewriting the reviewed edition, provenance, rights, or decision records.

validation.notes: Review digest round-trips; edits do not inherit approval; updates to release, rights, provenance, and review rows are rejected.
